The audit pass compares normalized bodies pairwise and flags any pair above the similarity threshold as a near-duplicate candidate for merging. Both files carry the same ruling text copied word for word from the same source note, which is exactly the drift the archive pass exists to remove before the two copies diverge any further. The beta copy adds nothing beyond it.
